charts.title: TOI-5293 A b: orbits around TOI-5293 A
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5293 A's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5293 A b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Cañas et al. 2023 (2023AJ....166...30C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CA_NTILDE_AS_ET_AL__2023): P 2.930289 d

charts.title: TOI-5293 A b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5293 A b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (70, 92) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 250111245, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 7 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
